text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Nice run, me! A performance that has 
captivated everyone since my debut race.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I can see it! Swarms of reporters 
welcoming the new star who has descended 
like a comet.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Come, journalists! Celebrate this glorious 
day and interview me to your hearts' 
content!
(Silence...)

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Huh...? Is nobody here? Wait...!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Um, Opera O-san. Got time for an 
interview?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Just one person?!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I-I'm here too...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Opera O-san, that was such a wonderful 
run...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Plus Doto...?! No, but, this shouldn't be 
happening...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Trainer-kun, what is the meaning of this?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I'm not famous... Does this mean even the 
trendsetting journalists haven't noticed 
me...?

It's rare for an Umamusume to generate so 
much buzz right from her debut race.

T.M. Opera O had run into the harsh wall 
of reality for the very first time...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Bwahahaha! Splendid! Why, this is a true 
step forward.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Up until now, the number of reporters who 
came to interview me was zero.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Yet today is the day! Zero has become 
one. And that is far more difficult than 
turning one into ten."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
In other words, the curtain has undeniably 
risen on the legend of the End-of-Century 
Overlord!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"I'm thoroughly satisfied to have shown 
you a glimpse of the light! Bwahaha!"

...The walls of reality simply didn't 
exist before T.M. Opera O.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Well, now that you've made such a splendid 
debut, shall we move on to the next step?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Now then, Trainer-kun, onto our next goal!
choice_data_list: Let's see, the next target race is...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
No, rather than the target race, shouldn't 
we focus on attracting more reporters 
first?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I simply wish to save those souls who do 
not yet know of me and are trapped in the 
depths of despair.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Got any bright ideas, Trainer-kun? How can 
we attract more reporters?
choice_data_list: First off... maybe gain more fans?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Fans...?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I see... More fans bring more 
reporters. And more reporters bring even 
more fans...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Which came first: the chicken, the egg, or 
ME!? First me, then the egg! That's gotta 
be it!

I'm not entirely sure why, but she seemed 
convinced by the proposal.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Alright, it's decided. First, let's gain 
more fans. In order to do that...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
It's all about races! Run in race after 
race after race, so as many people as 
possible can see me shine!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Let's go, Doto! Bwahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Y-Yeees...!

T.M. Opera O spun on her heel in a dashing 
manner and strode off to who knows 
where...

...They're probably just getting carried 
away in the moment, so they must be 
waiting right outside the venue.
